suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Phân tích Dữ liệu Y tế
suggestions.reasoning: Your clinical background provides the essential domain expertise required to interpret healthcare data, which AI cannot replicate. By transitioning into a data-focused role within the health sector, you leverage your 7 years of experience while adopting AI tools to handle the technical data processing tasks.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: You already possess 'patient care' and 'electronic medical record' experience. Your strength in 'handling emergency situations' translates well to the high-pressure environment of data-driven decision-making in hospitals or health-tech firms.
